title: Yuki Amemiya, Yukino Ichihara's My Husband is a Doomsday Weapon Manga Ends
content: The December issue of Ichijinsha 's Monthly Comic Zero-Sum magazine published the final chapter of Yuki Amemiya and Yukino Ichihara 's My Husband is a Doomsday Weapon ( Danna-sama wa Shūmatsu Heiki ) manga on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball’s Frieza Armor Is Still Iconic After 28 Years & Here’s Why
content: Dragon Ball Z made its premiere with Toonami in 1998 , and the world was introduced to a vast array of new characters, power levels and looks to the franchise. One of newest wardrobes was the Frieza battle armor, which was worn by invading Saiyans.
author: ComicBook

title: Digimon Alysion Smartphone Card Game Opens Pre-Registration with New Trailer
content: Bandai Card Games' Digimon Alysion mobile card game announced on Thursday in a new trailer that pre-registration is open in 49 countries and regions. The game is planned for a 2026 release. The free-to-play game will feature online card battles. The game was initially announced during Digimon Con in March 2025.
author: ANN

title: Reiko Shimizu's Himitsu Season 0 Spinoff Manga Enters Final Arc
content: The December issue of Hakusensha 's Melody magazine announced on Wednesday that Reiko Shimizu 's Himitsu Season 0 ( Himitsu - The Top Secret season 0 ) spinoff manga will start its final arc in the magazine's February 2027 issue on December 25.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Ending Explained: Will There Be a Next Generation Sequel?
content: The Bleach anime has finally come to an end 22 years after its inception, fulfilling the dreams of fans who have long wanted to see the series reach a satisfying conclusion. The anime’s original run of 366 episodes ended in 2012, but the manga continued until its conclusion in 2016, when fans began demanding an anime…

title: TANUKI: Pon's Summer Game Launches on November 10
content: Kyoto-based indie studio Denkiworks announced during Nintendo 's Indie World Showcase on Wednesday that its TANUKI: Pon's Summer game will launch for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC via Steam on November 10.
author: ANN

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Showrunner Talks Season 2 Ending, Future Plans & More
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners has kicked off a new era of its franchise with the release of a new season of episodes with Netflix, and ComicBook got to dig into all sorts of spoiler filled details about the season with the showrunner behind it all.
author: ComicBook

title: Bana Yoshida Launches New Kui Otoko no Majо̄ to Kyūseishu Manga
content: Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Monday that Bana Yoshida will launch a new manga titled Kui Otoko no Majо̄ to Kyūseishu ( The Man-Eating Witches and The Seed of Salvation ) in the third 2027 issue on February 25.
author: ANN

title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center, Schrödinger's Call Games Get Switch 2 Releases
content: Shueisha Games announced during Nintendo 's Japanese Indie World 2026 livestream on Wednesday that the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and Schrödinger's Call games have both launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on the same day. An upgrade pack from the respective Nintendo Switch version is available for each game.
author: ANN

title: New Shonen Jump Anime Revival Raises Concerns With Sudden Schedule Change
content: A major Shonen Jump anime revival now airing new episodes this Fall has raised concerns about the state of its production with the sudden announcement of a recap episode coming next.
